title: android calling xdrip with miaomiao packets after very long time.
symptom: After a long period without readings, xDrip receives Miaomiao packets that appear to be from the sensor but with inconsistent timestamps and glucose values, causing the app to think a packet is recent when it is actually old, leading to incorrect data filling.
cause: The thread identifies that packets can arrive with an internal counter that is from an earlier time than the packet's timestamp, causing the code to misinterpret them as recent. Specifically, a reading with a timestamp of 04:58:35 had an internal counter from 7 hours earlier, leading to confusion and incorrect gap filling.
evidence_quote: As we can see on the last reading time is like the later reading but counter is from 7 hours ago. This causes our code to think that this is a recent packet.
